caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition divided into four equal quadrants by thin white lines forming a cross. The top left quadrant contains the image of a light-colored horse facing right, set against a dark blue background decorated with a pattern of small red dots and seven small white cross shapes above the horse. The top right quadrant shows a light-colored tree with drooping branches, resembling a willow, on a red background with a pattern of small blue dots. The bottom left quadrant mirrors the top left, with a light-colored horse facing right on a blue background with red dots and seven white cross shapes above it. The bottom right quadrant mirrors the top right, showing a light-colored tree with drooping branches on a blue background with red dots. The background of the entire image is a plain off-white or cream color. The composition uses primarily red, blue, off-white, and white tones throughout.
title: Coverlet Detail "Farmer's Fancy"
